checks: Final six ride types and rope shown with retained avatar or authored seated passenger. Motion timing is separately measured by camera_native_final02.
B1 connections and continuous stairs visible; both B1 floor pickers fit640x480, CityHall picker scrolls.
SFC actual1F carry and4F arrival show the physical opening and paired escalators.
Previously blocked northern crossing now has a visible third-person avatar and clear crossing.
Road paint is on asphalt; median, zebra and signal backs/fronts are physically distinct. A rear case is not a second illuminated front.
Bus production arrival/ride views are separate from labelled aerial fixture showing actual fleet.
backlog: Some fixed interior signs show mirrored text from their rear side; refine front/back wayfinding.
Subway hand poses can be aligned more precisely to individual rings.
limits: Representative procedural game-model review, not exhaustive126-building visual acceptance, real Seoul architectural accuracy, a subjective comfort guarantee or a performance/FPS measurement. Actual OS smoke is two short bike/scooter trips, separately recorded.
